flagged.title: Castles: Instruments of Conquest and Control
flagged.reason: The video explicitly claims there were roughly 50 castles in England in 1066 (confusing pre-conquest England with the 1086 Domesday survey), teaching students an incorrect figure that contradicts the specification's core point that pre-1066 England had only a handful of castles.

mark_affecting.quote: In 1066, there were roughly 50 castles in all of England. By 1100, that number had exploded to approximately 500.
